subject: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Rees <tim.rees@dataforge.com>, ops@dataforge.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating

Hi Tim / DataForge ops team,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Per our call I’m proposing a coordinated maintenance window to apply the 2026.3 patch to your private cluster running in your VPC/colo. This note contains the safety rails we’ll operate under, requested customer-impact constraints, and the rollback triggers we discussed.

High-level ask:
- Target maintenance window: Thu 2026-07-23 01:00–04:00 UTC (overnight ET) — please confirm your blackout windows.
- Patch set: runtime 2.14.1 (security micropatch), kernel network driver shim, and the RL-model-serving hotfix.
- Version pinning: we will keep customer instances pinned to 2.14.1 for 15 days post-rollout unless you explicitly opt-in to uplift.

Operational sequencing (short):
1) Preflight dry-run on staging 24h prior (Wed 07/22) with KV cache warmers.
2) Canary group (10% of pods) cutover with prefix cache preserved. Monitor PPS, p99 latency, and token-error rate for 30m.
3) If canary looks good, progressive ramp to 100% in 3 waves with 10m observation windows and automatic pause on regressions.
4) LAN gating: we’ll briefly place the service group into maintenance routing (traffic switched to hosted fallback) for network-level upgrades — expected 90s per node; we’ll drain active streams before the gate.

Rollback triggers (will abort & roll back immediately):
- p50 increase >100ms AND p99 increase >200ms sustained for 3 consecutive observation windows
- Token error spike >1% absolute
- Failed health checks on >5% of instances after warmup

Comms & contacts:
- Primary on-call (Redwood): Chloe Martin (me) — +1 650 555 0123
- Escalation (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
- Your primary ops channel: ops@dataforge.com (please add any secondary contacts)

Attachments: draft runbook, canary schedule, updated network diagram.

Please confirm: (1) window works, (2) permission to perform the LAN gate with 90s per-node planned downtime, (3) any internal compliance or audit notifications we should include.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

---
Attachment stubs: 20260714-lan-gating-runbook.pdf (runbook), 20260714-canary-schedule.csv (CSV), network-diagram-v2.png (PNG)
From: Tim Rees <tim.rees@dataforge.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, ops@dataforge.com
Cc: Sarah Holt <sarah.holt@fenwickhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:38:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating

Hi Chloe — thanks for the detailed plan. Quick answers up front:
- Window: 2026-07-23 01:00–04:00 UTC is acceptable for our EU/US clusters; APAC must be excluded (we’ll run a different cadence).
- LAN gating: ok on the 90s per-node assumption, provided you coordinate per-rack to avoid simultaneous drain of critical feeds.

Couple of clarifying questions for the runbook:
1) Does the canary wave preserve pinned model versions or will it use the runtime+hotfix only? We need to avoid an accidental model uplift during the canary.
2) For telemetry: can you post a CloudWatch/Prometheus dashboard link in the runbook so our SREs can view the same panels?
3) Compliance: Fenwick Health requires us to retain audit logs for 180 days and to produce a signed change record for their auditors.

I’ve looped ops@dataforge and Sarah (customer compliance lead) so they can confirm the retention requirement. We’ll also need the DocuSign change record before the window.

—Tim
Tim Rees
Head of Platform Ops | DataForge Solutions
tim.rees@dataforge.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Rees <tim.rees@dataforge.com>, ops@dataforge.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating

Tim — great questions. Answers inline and updated plan below.

1) Canary model behavior: canary will run the same pinned model binaries — only the runtime and serving hotfix are applied. We will not perform any model version lifts during this operation. I’ll add an explicit gating check in the runbook to block any image tag changes.

2) Telemetry: added to runbook — link to shared Grafana board (read-only) and Prometheus query set. See related_links (Drive) and runbook attachment.

3) Compliance: we will generate the signed change record (DocuSign) and include the 180-day retention clause in the post-mortem. Please confirm the legal contact; I’ll initiate the DocuSign and copy ops.

Operational tweaks:
- Canary length increased to 45m to account for longer tail traces reported by Fenwick Health.
- Added an automated smoke-check step post-drain to validate token flows before releasing traffic back.

I’ve attached an updated runbook (v2) and the canary CSV that maps hostnames to waves.

If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30m preflight shiproom on Wed 07/22 16:00 UTC to walk through checks.

Thanks,
Chloe

---

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:22:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating

Chloe / Tim — quick acknowledgement from my side. Two tactical asks from infra: 
- Please include an explicit KV cache flush-and-warm step for canary hosts (script name: kv_warm_and_check.sh) in the runbook. Without it we see cold-cache latency spikes on first rotation.
- Define the exact rollback command (we should avoid manual handoffs). I suggest the runbook include a single-line rollback CLI and a playbook link (RB-2026-07-14, section 4.2).

I’ll be on the preflight shiproom Wed 16:00 UTC.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment maintenance: synchronization window & LAN gating

Thanks all — scheduling note and final checklist: 
- Preflight shiproom: Wed 2026-07-22 16:00 UTC (30m) — invite sent to ops@dataforge.com and team.
- Production window: Thu 2026-07-23 01:00–04:00 UTC. Final go/no-go at 00:30 UTC.
- DocuSign change record: Chloe to initiate by Thu 2026-07-16 EOD.
- Audit logs: DataForge compliance confirmed 180-day retention; Laura to own post-mortem deliverable internal side.

Escalation chain (if rollback required):
1) Redwood on-call (Chloe)
2) Redwood infra lead (Rishi)
3) DataForge ops lead (Tim)

If no objections I’ll lock the shiproom and notify CS and legal.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
